sentences.en: The latter half of the drama was a little dull.
sentences.zh: 戏剧的后半部分有点枯燥。

sentences.en: The former is inferior to the latter in some respect.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面后者优于前者。

sentences.en: Many support the former alternative, but I prefer the latter.
sentences.zh: 许多人支持前一个选择，但我更喜欢后一个选择。

senses.zh: 后者的；后一半的，接近终了的
